text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back home from an outing,
Silence
Suzuka suddenly stops in her
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, it's just...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow her line of sight to find an
arcade.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just inside sits a claw machine filled with
an
assortment of snow globes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking how pretty those are.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If it's okay with you...
choice_data_list: 気になるなら行ってみよう
choice_data_list_en: If you're curious, let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Then I'd love to. Just a quick little
detour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head inside and make our way
directly to the
claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm supposed to press this button
to move
the claw, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm fine. You don't have to worry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or so she says.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't do that! Why's it going
there?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The claw arm slowly extends downward
and
scoops up a great big bunch of
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Can I go get some more coins? I want to
try just a
few more times...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. A miniature field of sparkling
white snow...
choice_data_list_en: Do you want it that badly?
Do you want it that badly?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can imagine how pretty it would look
sitting in
my room...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can imagine how pretty it would look
sitting in
my room...
choice_data_list: 代わりにやってみてもいい？
choice_data_list_en: Can I try doing it instead?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you. That globe will be mine...
choice_data_list: 代わりにやってみてもいい？
choice_data_list_en: Can I try doing it instead?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, right... Um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Could you give me some advice? Like
you do
before a race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka seems determined to get
a snow
globe, so I give her some tips.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay... So, first... carefully, over the
top...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then watch from the side as—oh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It fell... Okay, one more time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And another, and another, and another.
She
keeps trying until, finally...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The claw carries a snow globe to the
collection
tray and drops it in!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I did!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This beautiful snowy landscape is mine
to view
whenever I want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka looks very pleased with
herself as
she carries her new snow globe
home.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Could it be that you want one too?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Really? Oh, please try then!
choice_data_list: 取れたらスズカにあげるよ
choice_data_list_en: If I get it, I'll give it to you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I trade spots with Silence Suzuka and
take the
controls.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Careful... Careful...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh! You grabbed one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-thump!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-you did it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... Can I really have it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because if you were to change your mind
later,
I'm not sure I'd be able to let it
go...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: For me...
choice_data_list: スズカにあげるために取ったんだよ
choice_data_list_en: I won this so I could give it to you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Now, I wonder where I
should put it in
my room...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When I've decided, you'll be the first to
know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka seems to be in a good
mood as
she carries her new snow globe
home.
